summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K attaching a notice and proxy statement for its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for July 28, 2026. The meeting covers routine proposals: re-appointment of auditors (Kesselman & Co.), re-election of two directors (Rick D. Scruggs and Shmuel Cabilly), and approval of CEO Dror Ben-Asher's engagement as Chairman. The board recommends a FOR vote on all items. There are no transaction terms, premiums, or special situation mechanics. This is a standard procedural filing with no corporate event warranting special-situations classification. What to watch: nothing material; routine shareholder meeting. Non-US filing mapped to US proxy circular equivalent.
